check_engine_is_remote: check if an object detection engine type is a remote API variant using ObjectDetectionEngineType.is_remote_variant
create_engine_options: create object detection engine options with a specified engine type and confidence score threshold
run_object_detection: run object detection inference on a PIL image using an ObjectDetectionEngineInput and engine instance
resolve_engine_options_from_dict: resolve engine options from a dictionary by looking up the engine type in the options registry
get_label_mapping: get the label mapping dictionary that maps integer label IDs to human-readable label names
